description.from: External rename/transfer is explicitly PAUSED pending resolution with the project owner of https://github.com/achrafash/gitbouncer, an existing tool for private-repository share links. Its purpose differs, but the Git/privacy branding overlap is material. Verified target is DataParade-io through existing BotSpy ownership; authenticated account has source admin and destination repository-creation permission. Source access currently includes a team grant that cannot be assumed to survive cross-organization transfer. Preserve access without expanding team or credential permissions. No external rename, transfer or access change has occurred. Codex owns the technical preparation; the project owner must resolve branding before external action resumes.
